verdict.rationale: Gram is an AI control plane and MCP gateway, a kind of platform that could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents cron, scheduled jobs or recurring workflows. Deployments, CLI deployment monitoring and on-demand skills are one-off or on-demand actions, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
